method.composition: NFI ecodistrict n_trees by province token, retained in full; documented pilot assumptions for AB/ON/NS/NU
method.volume_index: SCANFI forest area x RSYC age-100 volume per hectare; exact classes direct; BROADLEAF/CONIFEROUS aggregate volume allocated by stem share
method.proxy: published taper parameter or species is not the same as the composition taxon
method.gap: aggregate class or missing published taper mapping

limitations: Eligible shares are model estimates from open composition and curve data, not inventory.
AB, ON, NS and NU use documented pilot assumptions limited to taper-supported species; their 100% mapped coverage is conditional and not a complete species audit.
SCANFI BROADLEAF and CONIFEROUS aggregate volumes are allocated by NFI/assumption stem shares; this is a proxy.
A donor taper is published but not locally calibrated; local vs donor is reported separately.
No national supply, AAC, investment, official grade, UI or public OSeCAN claim is made.
No request, DUA or restricted data is a dependency.
